images.author: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)
images.why: Caption confirms a colourized SEM of blue human RSV virions shedding from A549 lung epithelial cells, with yellow anti-RSV F protein/gold antibodies. Best filamentous match; dense detail suits a 9:10 crop. Native resolution could not be independently verified.

images.author: NIAID
images.why: Caption identifies a TEM of a green human RSV particle labelled with yellow anti-RSV F protein/gold antibodies, using Halloween colours. Strong single-particle alternative. This is the 1024-pixel Flickr variant; a larger download could not be verified.
